_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Paper for Game Design's run-mode.md (docs/design, section 2): offer-card lines (Rampage, Proving ground, Crossing), the boss's lines by boss, and the endings. Every line passes the lint (4 to 12 words, banned words, no sensitive word: Legal c07 and c08). {place} is the place's name from place_names.json. Legal reads the endings for c08 before Orb sees them. For Orb's marks. Version 2 (2026-10-16 night): boss lines re-cut to the Gemini-reviewed bibles.

offer_cards.text: He's already in the streets of {place}.
{place} is full of people. He's walking in.
Get to {place} before he reaches the square.
{place} has been hit before. He's back.
What's left of {place} is in his way.
Thin air, hard rock. He's waiting up there.
Nothing out here but sand and him.
Cold, white and empty. He's stronger now.
Open water, no cover. He's already risen.
He's gone up a step. Come and see.
A quiet road and a plain fight.
{place} is on the way. Catch your breath.
Just a fight. Rest comes after.
You've been through {place} before. It remembers.

boss_moments.when: The boss lands the first blow of the fight.
The ground answers: the quake when the boss's first region breaks.
The boss takes the tier-5 form.
The boss starts a crust breach (a beam bored down into the ground).
The boss starts a blast cloud.
The boss takes the fight up out of the sky.
The boss's finisher lands on him: he loses.

boss_lines.text: Too slow. You're a warm-up, nothing more.
Fluke. Try that twice, clown.
Feel that? Even the ground's afraid.
You wanted all of me. Here.
Watch your footing. It's getting hot.
Look up. This is what I've got.
Follow me up, if you can.
Not yet. I've still got more.
Tch. Lucky. Don't get used to it.
You held back. Third-rate to the end.
Hahaha! First blood to us, rat!
Gahaha! You struck us? Now we strike back!
The ground trembles. It knows who rules.
Revision Twelve, insect! Look at it!
Mind the cracks, rats. They're our decree.
A blast cloud! How very grand.
Up we go. The view is better.
Hahaha! You made us bleed? Impossible!
We lost. I lost. Tell nobody.
Crawl home, petitioner. We're not finished!
Gotcha! Plenty of protein in you!
Ow! That dented my chassis, you snack!
Ground's shaking! My stomach's shaking louder!
Limiter's off! Everything on you looks tasty!
Magma! I'm gonna eat it by the spoon!
That smoke's real! Get clear of it!
Up we go! Thin air burns calories!
Chip's cracking! I'm so hungry I'm shaking!
Systems failing! Somebody, feed me!
Full at last! Thanks for the protein!
You're quicker than I expected.
That stung. Do it again.
Feel that? The ground knows me.
Here's what I really am.
Hold on. The floor's about to go.
Look at the sky. All mine.
Come up and meet me.
Not yet. I'm still standing.
You win. This time.
Is that all you had?

lines.text: Most of the planet's people are safe.
We're alive. The cities will take time.

endings.note: The planet's state: most of its people alive.

lines.text: Half the planet's people are gone.

endings.note: The planet's state: about half lost. The toll is a count, never bodies (Legal c08).

lines.text: Most of the planet's people are gone.
I'm sorry. I couldn't stop it.

endings.note: The planet's state: most of its people lost. No cheer, no score.

lines.text: I stopped joking after the first city.
We saw you go quiet. We understood.

endings.note: The hero's branch history: always witnessed.

lines.text: I let them go first, every time.
And you loved every second of it.

endings.note: The hero's branch history: always tested.

lines.text: Quiet or loud, I just kept fighting.
Make up your mind, will you?

endings.note: The hero's branch history: crossed between the two.

lines.text: The sky is still dark. The ash is slow to fall.

endings.note: When the blast cloud darkened the sky and it has not cleared.
